title: Self Assessment commercial software suppliers
text:
You can use the software suppliers in this list to submit valid tax returns, supplementary pages and attachments for the products in this guide.

 Some commercial software includes a feature that allows you to get details from HMRC to help you:

 • complete your client’s Self Assessment tax return if you’re an agent 

 • complete your Self Assessment tax return if you’re an individual 

 Check with your software supplier to find out if their product includes the feature.

 If you sign in to HMRC online services using GOV.UK One Login, you will need to create a unique user ID and password to submit your Self Assessment tax return using commercial software .

 Get technical support if you’re a Self Assessment software developer .
